The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 984d0d4287bc29fc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. statement: For every pair of integers n, m ≥ 1, the matrices in (13), with d = (n − 1) m 2 ! + m, form a rational hitting point for the following class over every characteristic-zero field F: nonzero polynomials f = P w fwxw ∈ F⟨x1, . . . , xn⟩ whose coefficients admit a representation fw = uBwv, where u ∈ F1×m, v ∈ Fm×1, and B1, . . . , Bn ∈ Matm(F) are strictly upper triangular. The tuple depends only on n, m and can be constructed in time polynomial in n, m, measured in bit operations.
